summary: Container growth ports: 80/443 for EDA to hub and controller, controller to hub, and gateway to controller, hub and EDA; 5432 PostgreSQL from each component to the database; 6379 Redis for EDA and gateway; 8443 internal gateway NGINX; 27199 Receptor from controller to execution containers; 8080/8443 controller NGINX.
questions: What ports does containerized AAP growth topology use?
Which port does Receptor use in containerized AAP?
What is port 6379 used for in AAP?
Which components connect to the database on port 5432?

answer_card.title: Container growth topology ports
answer_card.answer_md:
| Port | Use |
|---|---|
| 80/443 | EDA → hub/controller, controller → hub, gateway → controller/hub/EDA |
| 5432 | PostgreSQL from gateway, controller, hub, EDA |
| 6379 | Redis for EDA and gateway |
| 8443 | internal gateway NGINX |
| 8080/8443 | controller NGINX |
| 27199 | Receptor, controller ↔ execution containers |
